name: Limo, chauffeur and party bus

pf.license.need: where the state's or the local for-hire authority's rules require it: a for-hire passenger carrier permit for the business (a livery, limousine or charter-party permit), each vehicle registered and inspected for for-hire use; a business registration everywhere
pf.license.federal: federal operating authority and a USDOT number where federal rules require them (trips across state lines; larger vehicles): a generic federal switch
pf.license.who: the business holds the permit, the vehicles' papers and the insurance; each chauffeur holds the driver's license the vehicle needs and, where the state's or local rules issue one, a for-hire driver permit
ask: the carrier permit number, where one applies
each vehicle: type, legal seat count, plate, inspection date
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks: a required permit that the owner says the business lacks keeps the business offline; a vehicle past its inspection is never offered; a party bus is never offered without a chauffeur holding the license it needs
pf.license.renewals: optional reminders the owner sets; a license the owner says has lapsed pauses that person's new bookings for that work (the owner's word, never a check)
pf.license.insurance: commercial auto liability at the level the state's rules, or federal rules for interstate carriers, set by seat count; proof before going live
pf.license.drivers: a commercial driver's license with a passenger endorsement where federal rules require it (vehicles built for 16 or more people, driver included); background and driving-record checks where the state's or local rules require them; drug and alcohol testing where federal rules require it
pf.license.otherwise: identity checked; customers see no permit claim until it's confirmed
pf.license.how it's checked: Not checked by Rosie. The owner keeps each permit, each chauffeur's license and check, and the insurance; shown as given (D96).

pf.services.shape: event: a vehicle and a chauffeur for a date and a span of hours, along a route of a pickup, stops and a drop-off; hourly with a minimum, or a flat transfer; the vehicle is the capacity, with a chauffeur licensed for it. Flow A: tour seats from the company's own lot, and a free vehicle viewing
pf.services.examples: the example company's own prices, not a standard

list.name: Wedding package, stretch limo (up to 10)
list.price: $150 an hour, 4-hour minimum on Saturdays ($600), plus the 20% driver gratuity ($120) (example)
list.where: pickup at the customer's place, the ceremony, photos, the reception
list.before: a 25% deposit when the contract is signed
list.after: the rest charged to the saved card when the chauffeur texts DONE; overtime, tolls and parking after

list.name: Party bus (up to 30)
list.price: $250 an hour, 4-hour minimum, plus the 20% driver gratuity (example)
list.before: a 25% deposit when the contract is signed
list.after: the rest charged to the saved card when the chauffeur texts DONE

list.name: Prom package
list.before: paid in full when a parent signs the prom agreement
list.after: nothing more, unless overtime or cleaning
list.note: no alcohol; the route set ahead; students dropped only at the listed address

list.name: Airport transfer, sedan (up to 3) or SUV (up to 6)
list.price: $95 / $125 flat each way to the regional airport (example)
list.after: the saved card charged at drop-off, with tolls and parking
list.note: arrivals: the flight is tracked; 30 minutes of waiting after landing included, then $15 per 15 minutes

list.name: Hourly chauffeur, sedan or SUV
list.after: the saved card charged at drop-off

list.name: Funeral family car
list.note: booked by the family or the funeral home; a date that can't move; no sales texts and no rating request

list.name: Custom itinerary (a multi-stop night, a long trip)
list.kind: quoted from the customer's answers first
list.before: a 25% deposit with the signed contract
list.after: the rest charged to the saved card when the chauffeur texts DONE

list.name: Brewery tour seat (flow A)
list.where: from the company's own lot, Saturdays 12pm to 5pm, three stops
list.note: 21 and over only, ID at boarding; tasting fees are paid at each stop, not through Rosie; runs with 8 seats sold by 48 hours before

list.name: Overtime
list.price: per 30 minutes past the booked hours, at the hourly rate plus gratuity
list.note: only with the booker's yes, within the chauffeur's legal hours and before the vehicle's next booking

list.name: Extras
list.price: an extra stop on a flat transfer $20; a child car seat $15; cleaning fee $250 when a passenger is sick or a spill needs cleaning (in the contract, charged only with photos and the owner's yes); damage at cost (example)

pf.services.capacity: one booking per vehicle at a time, with 30 minutes between bookings for cleaning and travel (example); never more passengers than the vehicle's legal seat count; a chauffeur whose license fits the vehicle
pf.services.nobody_home: no: a passenger meets the chauffeur at pickup

beforeTimes: the date, the pickup time, and how many hours (or one way)
the kind of trip: a wedding, a prom, a birthday, an airport ride, a night out, a funeral
how many passengers (it sets the vehicle)
the pickup town and kind of place, the stops, and the last drop-off
whether any passenger is under 21 (no alcohol on the trip) or under 18 (the prom rules, car seats)
for an airport pickup: the flight number
afterTime: the day-of contact's name and mobile
the name for the chauffeur's sign at arrivals
securePage: the full street addresses of the pickup, stops and drop-off
the prom passenger list: names, ages and each parent's mobile
a passenger's accessibility needs (a wheelchair, a step that's too high)
a child's age and size for a car seat
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult; 21 or older when alcohol may be brought on the trip (the example company's rule); a prom is booked by a parent or guardian, who signs the prom agreement

stop.words: someone hurt or in danger right now

pf.safety.refuse: drugs, alcohol for anyone under 21, more passengers than seats, or riding outside the windows or the sunroof: refused, and the owner is told
pf.safety.alcohol: passengers 21 and over may bring their own drinks only where the state's and local rules allow alcohol in a for-hire vehicle; the chauffeur never serves or sells it unless the business holds the license for it; no glass on the party bus (the company's rule); anyone under 21 aboard means no alcohol on the whole trip
pf.safety.endTrip: the chauffeur may end a trip early, with no refund, for alcohol or drugs with a minor aboard, fighting, damage on purpose, or riding outside a window (the contract's rule); an emergency: pull over and call 911, then the owner
pf.safety.seats: every passenger has a seat and a belt where fitted; never more than the legal seat count
pf.safety.driverHours: a chauffeur never drives past the hours federal or state rules allow (the federal hours-of-service rules for commercial-license drivers) or the company's own limit; overtime that would break them is refused
pf.safety.weather: snow, ice or a storm: the owner may move or shorten a trip; the chauffeur may stop when it's unsafe to go on

steps.name: Signed contract
steps.when: before the deposit (weddings, party buses, custom quotes, funerals)
steps.result: signed by both: it books; not signed in 24 hours: the time is let go

steps.name: Prom agreement
steps.who: each student's parent or guardian signs: no alcohol, no drugs, the route and the drop-off
steps.result: signed: the student rides; not signed: that student doesn't ride

steps.name: Final passenger count and itinerary
steps.result: the vehicle and the hours are confirmed; a bigger group may need a bigger vehicle (the owner decides)

steps.name: Flight number
steps.when: at booking, for an airport pickup

steps.name: Vehicle viewing
steps.when: optional, before a wedding or prom booking

prepForReminder: The chauffeur arrives 15 minutes before the pickup time
Anyone who will drink brings an ID (21 and over)
Car seats: bring the child's own, or we bring the ones you booked

pf.visit.checkIn: the chauffeur arrives 15 minutes early; the booker or the day-of contact gives the check-in code at the vehicle; at the airport, at the meeting point; tour guests give their own code at boarding, with an ID for 21 and over
pf.visit.during: the route in the contract; extra stops or more time only with the booker's yes, priced first, within the chauffeur's legal hours and before the next booking
pf.visit.waiting: an airport arrival includes 30 minutes after landing, then waiting is billed per 15 minutes; hourly trips run from the pickup time to the last drop-off
pf.visit.done: DONE at the last drop-off; the chauffeur checks the vehicle with the booker for left items, cleaning or damage, with photos
pf.visit.extraWork: overtime, an extra stop, tolls and parking: billed after on the saved card, line by line
pf.visit.lostItems: items left in the vehicle are held at the garage, and the booker is told

pf.money.before: weddings, party buses and custom trips: a 25% deposit when the contract is signed (a deposit cap where the state's rules set one); proms: paid in full when the parent signs; airport transfers: a card saved, charged when the chauffeur texts DONE; tour seats: paid in full; the viewing: free
pf.money.after: the rest of a wedding or party bus is charged to the saved card when the chauffeur texts DONE, never on a set day; overtime, tolls, parking and any cleaning or damage fee go on the saved card after the trip, with photos and the owner's yes
pf.money.gratuity: the 20% driver gratuity on hourly bookings is a mandatory charge: named in the first price, the contract and the bill, never called optional; any extra tip is the customer's choice (tips line on)
pf.money.cancel: the contract's schedule: the deposit is kept when cancelled under 30 days before, the full price under 72 hours (example); transfers: free cancel until 24 hours before
pf.money.noShow: nobody at pickup 30 minutes after the time, and no answer: the booked minimum is owed, per the contract
pf.money.tax: sales or transport tax where the state's or local rules charge one (the owner's setting)
pf.money.two_dollars: $2 per confirmed booking; a wedding with several pickups is one booking

pf.messages.never: a prom passenger list, ages, a child's details, a passenger's health or accessibility needs and any money details never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: chauffeur texts: the booker's name, the vehicle, the pickup time and street, and the route; the passenger list opens on the secure link
pf.messages.sensitive: a funeral booking: no sales texts, no offers, no rating request
pf.messages.minors: a prom's texts go to the parent who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each chauffeur: the driver's license the vehicle needs (a commercial license with a passenger endorsement for vehicles built for 16 or more people, a federal rule); a for-hire driver permit where the state's or local rules issue one; background and driving-record checks where required; drug and alcohol testing where federal rules require it
pf.staff.skills: sedan and SUV, stretch limo, party bus, airport meet and greet, weddings, proms (two years with the company, its own rule), funerals
pf.staff.supervision: a prom party bus carries an attendant besides the chauffeur (the company's rule)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs proms, party buses, trips over 100 miles, custom itineraries and any alcohol question
pf.staff.standIn: a chauffeur may be swapped for another with the right license for the vehicle, and the booker is told; a wedding, prom or funeral date can't move: a stand-in or a full refund
pf.staff.hours: the chauffeur's legal hours decide whether overtime or a second trip that day can be taken

pf.rules.permit: the carrier permit number shown on the vehicle and the contract where the state's or local rules require it
pf.rules.contract: a written contract for charters where the state's rules require it, with the route, hours and price
pf.rules.alcohol: open alcohol in a for-hire vehicle only where the state's and local rules allow it; never with anyone under 21 aboard
pf.rules.federal: federal hours-of-service, drug and alcohol testing and commercial-license rules, where they apply
pf.rules.seats: never more than the legal seat count; belts where fitted; child car seats where the state's rules require them
pf.rules.records: trip records (times, chauffeur, vehicle) kept 7 years by default
pf.rules.cancel: the cancel schedule as signed in the contract

pf.edges.flightLate: a late flight: the pickup moves with the flight; waiting charges start only 30 minutes after it lands
pf.edges.moreTime: the booker asks for more time during the trip: priced first, the booker says yes, only within the chauffeur's legal hours and before the next booking
pf.edges.sick: a passenger is sick in the vehicle: the contract's cleaning fee, with photos and the owner's yes
pf.edges.minorsAlcohol: alcohol or drugs found with a minor aboard: the trip ends, the parent who signed is called; no refund (the contract)
pf.edges.tooMany: more passengers than seats at pickup: only the seats ride
pf.edges.breakdown: a backup vehicle, or a refund for the time lost
pf.edges.driverOut: another chauffeur with the right license; a wedding, prom or funeral date can't move
pf.edges.weather: the owner may move or shorten a trip; a wedding date can't move: a shorter route or a refund
pf.edges.lostItem: held at the garage; the booker is told
pf.edges.traffic: a road closure or traffic: the route changes; the booked time still counts

story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex M. books Lee Chauffeurs for a wedding stretch limo, 4 hours, from 14 Cedar Ln. Marco arrives Thu Oct 22 at 2:00pm, drives the party, and the rest is charged to Alex's saved card when Marco texts DONE.

notes: Limo, chauffeur and party bus (event style; from rentals, with the verified sample plug-in as the base, work/testdrive/limo.md). Refit for the rebuilt master (N4, Oct 27): the sample's money words are gone and money is the amounts rows. Flow B (Lee Chauffeur Service comes to the customer): a wedding stretch limo, 4 hours, $720 with the 20% gratuity, a $180 deposit when the contract is signed, the $540 rest charged to the saved card when the chauffeur texts DONE ($180 kept on a late cancel); an airport transfer, $125 flat, a card saved for a $60 late-cancel fee, charged at DONE; a prom package, $850 paid in full when the parent signs, $150 kept on a late cancel; a custom party-bus night quoted from the route at $1,200, a $300 deposit, the $900 rest at DONE. Flow A (Lee Limo Garage, the customer comes): a brewery tour seat for 21+, $69 paid in full ($20 kept on a late cancel), and a free vehicle viewing with nothing taken. The rest of a wedding or bus is never charged on a set day (the sample's 7-days-before line is removed). Licenses: permits, chauffeur papers and insurance are the owner's own, shown as given, never checked (D96). $2 applies to every booking (D97). Sensitive is off; children are covered by the children fact, and a prom's students' details stay on the secure page. The verified sample findings (work/gaps/limo.json) stand.
